level1.title: Defect types
level1.note: The three Level-1 defect types in the final taxonomy.

categories.label: Ambiguity
categories.description: More than one implementation-relevant interpretation is possible.

categories.label: Incompleteness
categories.description: A required methodological decision or component is missing.

categories.label: Inconsistency
categories.description: The specification conflicts with the supported method or artifact evidence.

level2.title: Defect categories
level2.note: The ten Level-2 categories in the final taxonomy.

categories.label: Ambiguous Definition
categories.description: A term or quantity has more than one implementation-relevant meaning.

categories.label: Ambiguous Procedure
categories.description: The described procedure permits different methodological choices.

categories.label: Missing Method Procedure
categories.description: A required algorithmic operation or step is not specified.

categories.label: Missing Model Structure
categories.description: A required part of the model architecture is not specified.

categories.label: Missing Data Specification
categories.description: Required data construction or preprocessing details are missing.

categories.label: Missing Configuration Protocol
categories.description: A required configuration or hyperparameter-selection protocol is missing.

categories.label: Missing Evaluation Specification
categories.description: A required evaluation choice or protocol is missing.

categories.label: Conflicting Objective
categories.description: The stated objective or loss conflicts with the supported method.

categories.label: Conflicting Model Design
categories.description: The architecture or pipeline conflicts with the supported implementation.

categories.label: Conflicting Formal Definition
categories.description: A formal definition conflicts with the supported method.

components.title: Method components
components.note: Original slot groupings, recomputed using the released real-world and synthetic split.

categories.label: Algorithm
categories.description: Method flow, inference behavior, and algorithmic decisions.

categories.label: Model
categories.description: Architecture, implementation structure, and model behavior.

categories.label: Loss
categories.description: Training objectives and supervision.

categories.label: Evaluation
categories.description: Evaluation metrics, baselines, and protocols.

categories.label: Data
categories.description: Data, inputs, outputs, and preprocessing.

categories.label: Training
categories.description: Optimization schedules and training procedures.
